projection.purpose: Separate build format from delivery route.

contract.input: Exact source identity, projection, format and destination configuration.
contract.step: Build-only writes an immutable local artifact.
Workshop delivery stages a preview for review.
Explicit publish delivery can bypass preview only for a configured destination.
contract.reject: An absent final destination keeps publication unavailable.

test.then: The preview may run; the final publish control remains unavailable.
